Ok so story time: The time I got dumped by a dude... in the name of the Lord 🙏🏻😭
I was heartbroken because he was the first “relationship-like “ with a dude I ever experienced. Questioned my own self worth, the whole 9 yards.

We stopped talking for a whole year, and right as the year mark hits... guess who texts me? Yup. He sure did. I was very hesitant to answer his texts but yall been stupid in love too so you get me. He invited me out for dinner and drinks, and to my surprise...he seemed different

We started dating, and right at the 1 month mark, he asked me to be his boyfriend. I was crying in happiness because thats all I wanted. To be taken serious and to be in an actual relationship. Everything was splendid and I was the HAPPIEST Ive ever been until...

One day, his family decided to come over to his place to watch a show. He had no idea they were coming and freaked out. Turns out... his family did not accept that he was gay. They’re extremely religious and well... in his eyes his family could not find out about us.
His behavior started changing towards me and there were many indicators that showed me he felt uncomfortable being in a relationship with me due to his family and the beliefs he was instilled.

When I came back to talk to him, he gave me a look in the eyes and told me... “Freddy I cant be with you, its not what God has intended for us. I think you should go and find a nice girl. I dont want you to go to hell for being with me”
I got up and walked so fast out of his house. I cried and cried and cried and did not know wtf to do. Because I mean... WHAT THE HELL DO YOU DO IN THAT SITUATION ??? 😭😭
I went back to my house, blocked him on everything and decided that would be the last time I ever fell for this man and these games in general.

I’ve been in such a bad emotional state over the last days/week that I completely stopped going to the gym. Today I finally went back because one of my sergeants asked me to train with him... its the little things man.
